value.rationale: The unique nontrivial type-A diagram symmetry has an exact all-rank, half-index Fibonacci character. This distinguishes rational invariant and sign homology and determines all ordinary path-reversal quotients rationally. The symmetry classification is not implied by the known Fibonacci ranks, and is applicable directly to comparison of path diagram orbit spaces.
